CODING AGENT · OFFICIAL-SOURCE REVIEW

Qwen Code

Qwen 团队维护的 Apache-2.0 编程 Agent，覆盖终端、IDE、桌面、Web 和聊天渠道，并支持多种模型提供商。

An Apache-2.0 coding agent from the Qwen team across terminal, IDE, desktop, web and chat, with multiple model providers.

结论：如果你希望在 Qwen、国内第三方 API、OpenRouter 或本地模型之间灵活切换，Qwen Code 很值得进入候选名单。它的覆盖面很广，但快速扩张也意味着配置、插件、模型兼容性和权限治理都需要真实项目验证。
Verdict: Qwen Code belongs on the shortlist when flexibility across Qwen, third-party APIs, OpenRouter or local models matters. Its broad surface is valuable, but configuration, integrations, model compatibility and permissions require hands-on validation.

它解决什么问题？

Qwen Code 将代码库理解、文件编辑、命令执行、MCP、技能、子 Agent 和自动化放进同一套工作流。官方入口已经从终端扩展到 VS Code、JetBrains、Zed、桌面端、实验性 Web UI 和聊天渠道。

首次启动可以选择阿里云百炼 Model Studio，也能连接 DeepSeek、MiniMax、智谱、Kimi、OpenRouter、自定义服务，以及通过 Ollama 或 vLLM 使用本地模型。对不想被单一模型供应商锁定的开发者，这是它最清晰的差异点。

为什么是 82 分？

What does it solve?

Qwen Code combines repository understanding, file edits, shell execution, MCP, skills, subagents and automation. Official surfaces extend beyond the terminal to VS Code, JetBrains, Zed, desktop, an experimental Web UI and chat channels.

First-run setup supports Alibaba ModelStudio, built-in third-party providers, OpenRouter, custom endpoints and local models through Ollama or vLLM. That provider flexibility is its clearest differentiator.

试用时重点看什么？

  • 用同一个仓库分别连接 Qwen、第三方 API 和本地模型，比较完成率与工具调用稳定性。
  • 确认自动模式、沙箱、工作树、MCP 与项目配置的权限边界。
  • 记录长上下文任务的模型费用、延迟、失败重试和人工修正时间。
  • 不要把“支持某协议”直接理解成所有模型都有相同的工具调用质量。

与 Gemini CLI 的关系

官方说明项目最初基于 Gemini CLI v0.8.2，之后停止同步并独立发展。今天应把它看作独立的多协议、多端 Agent，而不是简单换模型的 Gemini CLI 分支。

来源与边界

功能、安装、模型入口与许可证来自 Qwen Code 官方仓库和官方文档；指标来自 GitHub REST API。尚未完成同任务、多模型的统一实测，初评置信度 66%。

What should a trial measure?

  • Run the same repository task with Qwen, a third-party API and a local model.
  • Verify permission boundaries for auto mode, sandboxing, worktrees, MCP and project configuration.
  • Track cost, latency, retries and human correction time on long-context tasks.
  • Do not assume protocol support means equal tool-use quality across models.

How is it related to Gemini CLI?

The official repository says Qwen Code began from Gemini CLI v0.8.2, then stopped syncing and developed independently. It should now be evaluated as a separate multi-protocol, multi-surface agent rather than a simple model swap.

Sources and limits

Capabilities, installation, model options and licensing come from the official repository and documentation. Metrics come from the GitHub REST API. No standardized multi-model benchmark yet; confidence is 66%.
